description: Container images: linuxserver.io versioning, base image grouping

packageRules.description: Pin linuxserver.io images as version-<upstream>@sha256:... (e.g. version-4.0.17.2952, version-v1.6.2). These tags always point to the newest -lsNNN build, so rebuilds arrive as digest updates. Only version-* tags match, so develop-version-*, nightly-version-* and arch-prefixed tags are never proposed. -lsNNN tags are not supported: linuxserver.io restarts the counter and three-part versions lose the revision
